First Lien(3) | SOFR(Q) | 4.25% spread | 7.91% interest rate

findings.detail: C01 includes unfunded or undrawn commitment rows in the debt-row denominator even though the filing intentionally reports no interest rate for those rows.

rationale: The filing schedule distinguishes funded debt from unfunded commitments. In table 32 row 4, the instrument is explicitly First Lien - Undrawn and the reference, spread, and interest-rate fields are all dashes; table 32 row 8 shows a funded First Lien with SOFR(Q), a 4.25% spread, and a 7.91% interest rate. The filing also reports Total Unfunded Debt Investments separately at table 32 row 26. Thus the observed 67.1% coverage is not evidence of missing source data: C01's all-debt-row denominator includes rows for which a rate is not applicable. The check is overbroad, so the flag is a false alarm rather than a holdings-data error.
